# ada-url / can_parse

ada-url's own fuzz target `can_parse` ([source](source/can_parse.cc), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over ada (ada-url/ada at e6754478).

Checks 3 properties (listed below); the first, an API contract: can_parse(source) == parse<url_aggregator>(source).has_value() == parse<url>(source).has_value(); with a base: can_parse(source,&base) == parse(source,&base).has_value(), and can_parse_with_base must be false when the base itself does not parse.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against ada at commit e6754478.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
- The normalised href of a successful parse is accepted by can_parse, and re-parsing it (both types) yields the identical href ([lines 86-101](source/can_parse.cc#L86-L101)): abort(); not confirmed in the binary.
